proposal_text: AMENDMENT 1 (after independent VETO #102, findings R1-R4) of the Phase 17 gate-loop remediation. Pattern: gate-loop on qor-plan, recurring across Phases 15, 16 and 17 (Phase 16 overrides 1f15661a/f0b67f91; Phase 17 VETOs #96, #98, #100 in session 2026-10-10T0443-9d3df3, which itself has no process-shadow events; the session-total detector is blocked by Qor-logic-plus #173 and nothing was manufactured). Root cause: plans asserted empirical facts that were never executed against named commits; N3, N4 and F3 were design gaps the auditor still owns. Process change (gate): every docs/plan-qor-phase17+ plan carries a closed v2 qor-plan-claims manifest; scripts/plan_claims_check.py reads only immutable git objects (fixed git cat-file/ls-tree), requires full commit SHAs declared and recorded in prose, requires every known empirical assertion form in canonical sections to reference a claim or an auditor-challenged judgment exception, rejects missing/orphan/duplicate ids, and never executes plan-supplied commands. Red-first/regression-lock classifications fail closed until a separately controlled trusted harness exists. Mechanical detection is lexical and does not make arbitrary prose machine-verifiable; /qor-audit Step 3 keeps responsibility for undeclared assertions. Binding status: repository CI job 'Plan claims gate' runs fail-closed but blocks merges only after D1. Skill binding requires D2. Event closure (the addressed flip) is NOT legal until an independent reviews-remediate PASS AND D1 AND D2 are satisfied; until then this remediation is HOLD.
